import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.*
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(name="{{pref_name}}")
val KEY=stringPreferencesKey("{{key_name}}")
fun read(c:Context):Flow<String?> = c.dataStore.data.map{it[KEY]}
suspend fun write(c:Context,v:String){c.dataStore.edit{it[KEY]=v}}
